title: The path of an inbound packet through two NSGs to a VM

steps.title: Subnet NSG
steps.note: Checked first for inbound traffic. Lower priority numbers win; a deny drops the packet here.

steps.title: NIC NSG
steps.note: Must also allow the packet. An allow rule here cannot undo a deny at the subnet.

steps.title: The VM
steps.note: Replies are allowed automatically: the rules are stateful. Outbound order is NIC first, then subnet.

steps.title: Still blocked?
steps.note: Run Network Watcher IP flow verify: it names the rule that allowed or denied the packet.

before: Symptom: "the VNets are peered, but traffic does not get through"
caption: Follow an inbound packet card by card: both NSGs must allow it, and the subnet NSG decides first.
